allow: Shell(git add crates/twr-client/src/wreq_transport.rs crates/twr-graphql/src/consts.rs crates/twr/src/main.rs && git commit -F - <<'EOF' Fix list-write 214: cookie-jar off, queryId out-of-body, partial-data tolerance Three coordinated fixes for the CreateList 214 regression (live-found 2026-09-20): - twr-client: cookie_store(false) — transport must be stateless; the cookie jar was silently appending Set-Cookie rotations (guest token, cf_clearance) that overrode the explicit Cookie: header on follow-ups. - twr-graphql: drop CreateList from EXTRA_FALLBACK_IDS — the fallback rotation was tried first and shadowed the live-verified baseline, causing 214s while curl with the baseline QID returned 200. - twr: stop sending in-body queryId for list mutations — the Reottiwt shape is the 214 trigger (identical vars succeed via curl without it); twikit only adds queryId-in-body when features is None. - twr: partial-data tolerance — HTTP 200 with both data (mutation landed, id present) and a non-root errors[] entry (code 214 on list.default_banner_media_results.result) now reports success with a server-attached warning instead of a fake failure. - twr: fail-closed on pin/unpin before network — UpdatePinnedTimelines item shape is unconfirmed (live-probed: every guess 422s). EOF)
